Weeks (you need 500 votes earned in the Oramond Quest tasks)

Also known as *Voting Quest*. You earn votes by doing tasks in the {wiki:Oramond Quest} and spend them with {npc:Marvin} in the Rathleton Magistrate to decide shortcuts, dungeon monsters, bosses and raids. With each votes tier you go up a rank (Commoner, Inhabitant, Citizen and Squire), get an achievement and unlock new perks: selling loot to NPCs, Slime Slide, boat trips to more cities, the Underground Glooth Factory and the {wiki:Hero of Rathleton Quest}.
Oramond votes (shortcut, dungeon, bosses and raids)
With no rank you vote on the shortcut; as **Commoner** also on the dungeon; as **Inhabitant** also on the bosses.
Votes are earned from Oramond Quest tasks and reset to zero every 14 days.
After casting at least **50 votes** with {npc:Marvin}.
